title: S2TDR: Structured Multimodal Reconstruction for Sticker-Aware Dialogue Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.41176v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stickers are widely used in social media dialogues to express affect, stance, and intent beyond literal text. Their meanings are often non-literal and context-dependent, making them difficult to handle with generic visual fusion or standalone captioning. We propose Sticker-to-Text Dialogue Reconstruction (S2TDR), a structured multimodal reconstruction framework that converts sticker turns into contextually appropriate textual utterances. S2TDR decomposes sticker interpretation into visual cue extraction, affective-intent inference, and context-aware dialogue reconstruction, using OCR text only as an auxiliary cue when available. The reconstructed dialogue can then be consumed by existing text-based dialogue models. Experiments on sentiment analysis, intent recognition, and dialogue summarization show that S2TDR generally improves multiple downstream models over direct sticker integration methods. translated_title: S2TDR：面向表情包感知对话理解的结构化多模态重构方法
translated_abstract: 表情包在社交媒体对话中被广泛使用，用以表达字面文本之外的情感、立场和意图。其含义通常是非字面的且高度依赖上下文，这使得通用的视觉融合或独立的图像描述方法难以有效处理。我们提出了表情包到文本的对话重构方法S2TDR，这是一个结构化多模态重构框架，能够将对话中的表情包轮次转换为符合上下文的文本表达。S2TDR将表情包解释过程分解为视觉线索提取、情感意图推断和上下文感知的对话重构三个步骤，仅在OCR文本可用时将其作为辅助线索使用。重构后的对话可以进一步被现有的基于文本的对话模型所利用。在情感分析、意图识别和对话摘要任务上的实验表明，与直接的表情包集成方法相比，S2TDR通常能提升多个下游模型的性能。进一步的组件消融分析……
tldr: 提出S2TDR结构化多模态框架，将对话中的表情包通过视觉线索提取、情感意图推断和上下文感知重构转换为文本表达，从而提升情感分析、意图识别和对话摘要等下游任务的性能。
en_tdlr: S2TDR is a structured multimodal reconstruction framework that converts stickers in dialogues into contextually appropriate text utterances via visual cue extraction, affective-intent inference, and context-aware reconstruction, improving downstream tasks such as sentiment analysis, intent recognition, and dialogue summarization.
